findings.description: The policy grants unrestricted ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* permissions against every resource. This violates least privilege and can allow broad data access, infrastructure modification, and privilege-escalation paths through the permitted services.

A permanent IAM user access key is provisioned for the deployment user instead of using federated or temporary role credentials. Compromise of this key enables persistent use of the user's excessively broad permissions until it is manually revoked.
